bundle.identity: Tectonic indexed-tar bundle digest plus exact indexed path

provenance.sourceCache: temporary QA cache; no network access used by this builder
provenance.trust: Hashes pin the captured bytes and detect later corruption; they are not independent upstream authentication.

resources.encoding: gzip UTF-8 TSV: path, offset, length, sha256

sourceMetadata.scope: Literal references from UTF-8 .sty/.cls/.tex sources; every indexed .fd and .map path is inventoried. This static scan does not resolve TeX semantics.
sourceMetadata.unresolved: Macro-valued and otherwise non-literal arguments are retained as unresolved expressions.
